name: Service account authenticated interactively
description: Lab rule 4 of 5. The 365 day window is a lab-only concession, because this lab ships historical data. A production deployment of this rule would use a short window and would alert on the shape of the traffic rather than on one address. A service account is not a person and has no business holding an interactive console session. Some estates have local service accounts that legitimately do, which is exactly why this rule needs a human behind it rather than an automatic action.
query: event.code: 4624 and logon.type: "2" and user.name: svc-*
